name: Giving To The Poor
overview: Scripture calls believers to a generous and compassionate heart toward the poor, urging them not to harden their hearts or withhold help from those in need. Giving to the poor is portrayed as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such kindness, and it brings blessing to the giver. Jesus highlights the eternal value of sacrificial giving by instructing that selling possessions to give to the poor leads to treasure in heaven and discipleship. Practical commands include sharing clothing and food freely with those who lack, demonstrating that giving to the poor is an essential expression of obedience and faithfulness to God.
